events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV's impact
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? 45 years ago today, MTV launched and gave us 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first clip. What was the first music video that blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', on August 29, 1994, marking a pivotal moment in Britpop history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15 to August 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the Woodstock Festival brought together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace and Music'. Which iconic performance would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, passing away six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's legacy
angles.copy: Today marks 30 years since the tragic shooting of Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55. His powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop culture live on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, leaving behind a revolutionary musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, the world lost a true guitar innovator, Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and its famous cover art.

angles.name: Abbey Road magic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us the legendary 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable ever! What's your go-to track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style with The Pretenders are truly timeless.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam G
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' first graced our airwaves (US single release). A message of peace that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple revolutionized portable music with the release of its first iPod on October 23, 2001, featuring a 5GB hard drive and a scroll wheel.

angles.name: iPod changed everything
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago, Apple launched the original, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you own?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 64 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many unforgettable laughs.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968, a sprawling double LP.

angles.name: White Album turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A truly diverse and experimental record that still sparks debate. What's your standout track?
